name: horndogcop's Valenced Plugins
description: Valenced plugins by horndogcop: Hide User Content, Mention Block, and Negative Search Filters.

com.valenced.hide-user-content.name: Hide User Content
com.valenced.hide-user-content.description: Adds a user context menu item to hide or blur images and spoiler-wrap message blocks from selected users.
com.valenced.hide-user-content.author: horndogcop

com.valenced.mention-block.name: Mention Block
com.valenced.mention-block.description: Intercepts @user and #channel mention autocomplete to block users and channels from suggestions via context menus and commands.
com.valenced.mention-block.author: horndogcop

com.valenced.negative-search-filters.name: Negative Search Filters
com.valenced.negative-search-filters.description: Adds repeatable client-side negative inline search filters (-from:, -in:, -has:image, -has:embed, etc.) to Discord mobile search.
com.valenced.negative-search-filters.author: horndogcop
